finding.claim: With list.extendedFolderInfo enabled, each directory listing triggers an uncached, unbounded recursive stat walk of every listed subdirectory, enabling unauthenticated resource exhaustion.
finding.source: GET <dir>/ on a listed directory when list.extendedFolderInfo is true
finding.sink: dirList.getExtendedInfo recursive fs.stat walk (dirList.js:25-71) invoked from dirList.list (dirList.js:99-101)

trace.note: directory case calls dirList.send when opts.list set
unbounded recursion per level with new fastq queue

finding.guards_checked: Listing requires explicit opt-in list option; no depth or entry limit, no caching. Availability-only impact, config-gated, confidence low.
